name: Postsynaptic membrane and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: All members regulate maintenance of dendritic spines or organization of the postsynaptic membrane, whereas confusables concern spine morphogenesis, dendrite arborization, postsynaptic actin and synaptic plasticity.

name: Platelet activation with cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members are the platelet activation and cytoskeletal remodeling gene modules, distinct from confusables built on integrin-MAPK linkage, Rap1, fibronectin matrix and Rho-kinase signaling.

name: Neurofascin and NrCAM nodal sodium channel clustering
rationale: Neurofascin and NrCAM interactions and voltage-gated sodium channel clustering together describe node-of-Ranvier assembly, unlike confusables on DSCAM/nectin adhesion, myelination or axon regeneration.

name: Aldosterone-regulated renal sodium and potassium transport
rationale: Members regulate sodium and potassium transport across membranes, aldosterone and potassium responses and renal sodium handling, whereas confusables concern osmotic stress, chloride transport, or blood volume and filtration.

name: Amino acid and cholinergic neurotransmitter synthesis, transport and release
rationale: Members cover GABA, glutamate, glycine and acetylcholine synthesis, vesicular loading, reuptake, SLC transporter defects and clostridial toxin block of release, while the main confusable is defined by monoamine (catecholamine, serotonin) handling.

name: Cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium sequestration and contractility
rationale: Members regulate SERCA-type calcium uptake into the sarcoplasmic reticulum and its effects on cardiac relaxation, force and membrane potential, unlike confusables on Na/Ca exchange and heart rate control.

qualifier: germinal center and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center reaction and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover germinal center B cell and T follicular helper differentiation, ICOS co-stimulation, plasma cell and immunoglobulin modules and memory B cells, whereas confusables emphasise naive B cells, B cell development and generic memory responses.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression
name: RNA virus genome replication and viral gene expression
rationale: Members describe replication, transcription, translation and RNP assembly of influenza, coronaviruses and RSV and their manipulation of host translation, unlike confusables on retroviral DNA integration, herpesvirus events and translational frameshifting.

name: BRCA1-PALB2-BRCA2 homologous recombination strand exchange and defects
rationale: Members cover RAD51-mediated strand exchange, SDSA resolution and its failure through BRCA1, PALB2 and BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables cover end resection, single-strand annealing, alt-NHEJ and NHEJ.

name: Glycosaminoglycan and non-mucin O-glycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover heparan, chondroitin/dermatan and keratan sulfate proteoglycan synthesis and O-mannose, O-fucose and O-glucose glycosylation (dystroglycan, Notch, TSR) with their disease defects, unlike confusables on GAG degradation or N-glycan and mucin-type glycosylation.

Members mix fructose, PRPP, creatine and inositol metabolism, magnesium transport, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, protein oligomerization states and calcium-independent adhesion, with no shared biological theme.

qualifier: mesodermal migration and lateral plate mesoderm
name: Mesoderm migration and lateral mesoderm morphogenesis at gastrulation
rationale: Members cover germ layer formation, mesendoderm and mesodermal cell migration, lateral plate mesoderm formation and resulting gut morphogenesis, whereas confusables focus on endoderm specification, primitive streak and pluripotency factors.

name: Oncogenic FLT3 signaling to STAT5 and CBL regulation
rationale: Members cover wild-type and oncogenic FLT3 (ITD, fusion, CBL mutant) signaling through SRC kinases and STAT5 and its CBL-mediated negative regulation, unlike confusables on FLT3 inhibitor resistance, interleukin, EPO or PDGFR signaling.

name: Neutrophil degranulation and respiratory burst microbial killing
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil degranulation, superoxide and ROS production and killing of bacteria and fungi, whereas confusables concern macrophage programmes, neutrophil chemotaxis and formyl peptide receptors, or metal sequestration.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All members describe prefoldin-assisted CCT/TRiC folding of nascent actin, tubulin and other substrates, unlike confusables on G-beta folding, ER folding, refolding and aggregate handling.

name: V-ATPase-driven lysosomal and Golgi lumen acidification
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase assembly, proton transport and acidification of lysosomal and Golgi lumens, whereas confusables add endosomal and synaptic vesicle acidification, lysosomal pH elevation, pigmentation or bicarbonate transport.

name: Receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK activation
rationale: Members cover tyrosine autophosphorylation, downstream signal transduction and positive regulation of the ERK1/2 cascade, whereas confusables are defined by PI3K/AKT, FGFR PLC cascades or PDGF receptor regulation.

qualifier: respiratory complex assembly and iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis
name: Respiratory chain assembly, electron transport and iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis
rationale: Members cover electron transport, ATP synthesis, assembly of complexes I-V and respirasomes, and Fe-S cluster assembly feeding these and TCA enzymes, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein import, processing, cristae and heme synthesis.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage maturation and platelet morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet morphogenesis plus erythroid-megakaryocytic and terminal erythroid modules, whereas confusables emphasise RUNX1 control, myeloid progenitors and erythrocyte differentiation alone.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT striated muscle adaptation and cell size control
rationale: Members regulate muscle hypertrophy, atrophy, fiber-type transition, cell size and cardiomyocyte growth through calcineurin-NFAT signaling, unlike confusables on contraction rate and force or cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration.

core: Cotranslational protein targeting to endoplasmic reticulum
name: SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to ER
rationale: All members concern SRP-mediated signal sequence recognition and targeting of nascent proteins to the ER, whereas confusables concern Golgi and COPI/COPII vesicle traffic or ribosome termination and mRNA decay.

qualifier: snRNP biogenesis, splicing, 3'-end processing and export
name: snRNP biogenesis, mRNA splicing, 3'-end processing and export
rationale: Members cover snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly, major and minor spliceosome function, polyadenylation and histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export, unlike confusables on rRNA/Pol I/Pol III transcription and processing or mRNA decay.

name: Nuclear receptor control of adipogenesis and energy metabolism
rationale: Members cover PPAR, LXR, ROR/REV-ERB and PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation, triglyceride synthesis and gluconeogenesis, whereas confusables emphasise lipid droplet dynamics, lipolysis, ChREBP sugar signaling, thermogenesis or cholesterol.

name: Striated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: Members cover muscle hypertrophy, atrophy, fiber-type switching and calcineurin-NFAT signaling together with cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and muscle regeneration, unlike confusables centred on myoblast differentiation, myogenesis and sarcomere contraction.

qualifier: error-prone, by REV1, Pol iota and Pol kappa
name: Error-prone translesion synthesis by REV1, Pol iota and kappa
rationale: Members cover PCNA-dependent damage recognition, REV1, POLI and POLK lesion bypass and its termination, whereas confusables cover error-free POLH synthesis, base excision or nucleotide excision gap filling and replicative synthesis.
